definitions: The state or level of consciousness where sense data can be confirmed by an observer.
The state or quality of being aware of something.

blocks.text: Awareness is a state of knowing, understanding, or being conscious of something. Its precise definition is disputed and varies across disciplines. Some accounts treat it as a synonym for consciousness, while others characterize it as cognitive access to information that can occur without subjective experience. Awareness plays a central role in everyday life by helping individuals perceive their surroundings, monitor and regulate their behavior, and make information available to other cognitive processes.

Awareness is a 2023 Spanish-American science-fiction action thriller film directed by Daniel Benmayor, who also co-wrote the screenplay with Iván Ledesma, and Manuel Burque. It stars Carlos Scholz alongside María Pedraza, Pedro Alonso, Lela Loren, and Óscar Jaenada.

images.alt: Focal awareness encompasses contents at the center of attention, such as a text one is reading, while peripheral awareness encompasses objects outside the focus, such as the surrounding room noticed in the background while reading.[60]
The mirror test assesses self-awareness in animals by evaluating whether they recognize their reflection in a mirror.[81]
Neuroimaging, such as functional magnetic resonance imaging, is one way of studying awareness.[83]
